events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite Oasis track or solo anthem?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' (UK Single) turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1975 to promote his 'Shaved Fish' compilation album.

angles.name: Imagine the Impact
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since its UK single release, John Lennon's 'Imagine' remains a powerful message. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: Apple unveiled the first iPod 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how the world consumed music.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember the first time you held an iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple unveiled the device that put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changed music forever.

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', on this day in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme songs, what's your favourite 007 moment or track?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: A Legend Remembered
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're reflecting on the enduring legacy of John Lennon. What's the one song that always brings him to mind?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: And Now For Something Completely Different
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite moment from Monty Python, Fawlty Towers, or his incredible career?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as the 'White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: A Blank Canvas of Sound
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since its release, The Beatles' 'White Album' remains a monumental and eclectic masterpiece. Which track from this double album is your go-to?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost an undeniable legend. Remembering the unparalleled talent and stage presence of Freddie Mercury. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965.

angles.name: A Soulful Evolution
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed boundaries and showcased their evolving sound. What's your highlight from this classic?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering a Visionary
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message continue to resonate. What's the song that best captures his spirit for you?
